purpose: HMRC Annual savings statistics (September 2026 release), the rows the ISA subscriptions stage draws subscribers and amounts from and the Lifetime ISA anchor counts payers against (microcosm#1415): Table 9.7 2023-24 subscribers by total income and size of subscription, and the holders who made no further subscription, for all subscribers and each type paid into; Table 9.8 subscribers by age and sex; Table 9.9 subscribers by region; Table 9.4 accounts and amounts subscribed by component for 2023-24 and 2024-25 (the latest year provisional); Table 9.6 market values at 5 April 2025; the cash ISA limit reduction impact note's shares of under-65 cash subscribers either side of GBP 12,000 in 2022-23; and Lifetime ISA Table 1a withdrawals for 2024-25 and 2025-26. Tables 9.7 to 9.9 count individuals and Table 9.4 accounts. None is a calibration target: the stage's reviewed fence keeps them measured only. No value is derived here.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
